studies.label: ParCa initial-state agreement — v2ecoli vs vEcoli
Statistical equivalence — v2ecoli baseline vs vEcoli (basal, 4 seeds)

nodes.label: RESOLVED. Acetate was the one SIGNIFICANT divergence (growth +40.2%, p=0.049)...
nodes.statement: RESOLVED. Acetate was the one SIGNIFICANT divergence (growth +40.2%, p=0.049). After the fix v2ecoli reproduces vEcoli on acetate NATIVELY: the significant growth mismatch is gone (now +15.9%, p=0.28, not significant) and cell/dry/RNA/protein are all within tolerance; a small non-significant growth drift remains at the seed-noise level. Root cause: the ParCa ppGpp-expression NNLS set exp_free[rpoBC operon]=0 (a non-negativity boundary solution), inverting the RNAP-core (rpoB/rpoC) nutrient response and compressing assembled APORNAP-CPLX -> active_RNAP -> rRNA/growth. The fix restores a fold-change-consistent, basal-preserving rpoBC split.

nodes.statement: before -> after fix (4-seed gen-1, Welch t): growth +40.2% (p=0.049, MISMATCH) -> +15.9% (p=0.28, drift, NOT significant); RNA +13.8% drift -> +3.6% within_tol; cell +8.1% -> +2.3% within_tol; dry +8.1% -> +2.3% within_tol; protein +2.3% -> +1.3% within_tol. Overall mismatch -> drift. Native run on the fixed ParCa cache.

nodes.label: RESOLVED (short-horizon precursor run, 1 seed x 1 gen x 300 steps). The v2-si...
nodes.statement: RESOLVED (short-horizon precursor run, 1 seed x 1 gen x 300 steps). The v2-side tick-2 hang was a GlobalClock zero-advance deadlock, NOT a step-cascade non-convergence (the earlier theory was a downstream symptom). MetabolismRedux is a vivarium Step but was injected as an interval pbg process, so its next_update_time output applied a tick late and GlobalClock.calculate_timestep pinned at 0. Fixed in v2ecoli PR #389 (inject vivarium Step subclasses as pbg steps). v2ecoli now runs 301 redux steps in ~125 s and REPRODUCES genuine vEcoli on basal within_tol on all graded axes (worst matched-time median |delta| = 0.79%). This study now runs the full 2-seed x 3-gen x 15000-step shape; the perf-blocker finding is carried forward as historical context for the injection fix, not yet re-validated at this shape.

nodes.label: ROOT CAUSE (pinned by direct measurement, 2026-07-26): GlobalClock.calculate_...
nodes.statement: ROOT CAUSE (pinned by direct measurement, 2026-07-26): GlobalClock.calculate_timestep returns min(next_update_time - global_time) over the next_update_time map; it advances sim time by that full_step. MetabolismRedux (vivarium Step, update_condition-gated) inherits FBA metabolism's topology so its next_update_time wires to ('next_update_time','metabolism'). The inject bridge set as_step only from an explicit _force_step attr (which redux lacks), so redux was injected as an interval pbg PROCESS. As a process its next_update_time output is deferred to front-time global_time+interval and applies one tick late; at tick 2 nut['metabolism']==global_time==1.0 => calculate_timestep returns 0 => global_time frozen => _run_inner spins (~170k apply_updates rounds/tick). A probe recorded 4001/4001 zero-advance clock calls, argmin always the orphaned 'metabolism' key. FBA metabolism does not hang because it is built as partitioned Requester/Evolver STEPS (applied immediately in the cascade). FIX: _should_inject_as_step(cls) returns True for vivarium Step subclasses (PartitionedProcess already rejected as 'partitioned', so plain Processes stay processes); as a step the deriver applies within the tick so next_update_time advances before the clock recomputes. VERIFIED: redux basal advances global_time normally at ~0.4 s/tick; matched-timepoint gen-1 grade vs genuine vEcoli -- cell_mass 0.10%, dry_mass 0.10%, protein_mass 0.07%, rna_mass 0.52%, growth_rate 0.79% => within_tol all axes. See memory project_metabolism_redux_tick2_hang. (Supersedes the earlier STEP-CASCADE NON-CONVERGENCE theory and the missing project_metabolism_redux_injection_ode_stiffness memory.)

Root cause: the ParCa ppGpp-expression NNLS set exp_free[rpoBC operon]=0 (a non-negativity boundary solution), inverting the RNAP-core (rpoB/rpoC) nutrient response and compressing assembled APORNAP-CPLX -> active_RNAP -> rRNA/growth. The fix restores a fold-change-consistent, basal-preserving rpoBC split.
